title: breath_sigil params (r17 The Sigil of Breath)

shape.description: Star polygon {n/k} inside the circle; [7, 3] is a heptagram.

rhythm_sets.description: Seconds of [in, hold, out, hold]; one set is chosen per day.

words_cycles.description: Cycles during which the phase word shows.

span.description: Ring radius at empty and full, as a fraction of the maximum.

turn_per_cycle.description: Turns the star rotates per cycle (signed).

stop_at.description: Where in the final inhale the ring freezes.

hold_at_end.description: Seconds of stillness after the freeze before the rite ends.
